facts.fact: SARS says it applies artificial intelligence and machine learning to about 150 million third-party data records to auto-assess taxpayers and runs each outcome through fraud detection.

facts.fact: SARS reports over 5 million taxpayers auto-assessed in 14 days, 99.13% accepting the outcome, and R100 billion of impermissible refunds prevented last year.
